rationale: Optimal dispatch minimizes cost by setting diesel reactive power to its preferred value (4 Mvar), eliminating deviation penalty. P_diesel=20 MW satisfies all constraints: load balance (20+14=34 MW, 4+8=12 Mvar), diesel limits (8≤20≤45, -10≤4≤18), inverter capability (14²+8²=260≤576), and voltage (0.995 pu within [0.95, 1.05]). Total cost = 76*20 + 3*|4-4| = 1520.
